name: openbb_company_news
description:
Recent news articles about one company through the OpenBB Platform (obb.news.company).
Returns: {symbol, provider, data_points, truncated, articles: [records with date, title, text or summary, url, source]} or {symbol, error}.
Inputs (* required): symbol* (one ticker or comma-separated tickers); limit (articles; default 10); provider (benzinga, fmp, intrinio, polygon, tiingo, yfinance; default fmp).
Market-wide news: openbb_market_news; keyless: yf_news. OpenBB's yfinance news returns nothing at present, so the default is fmp. Keys: yfinance needs none; fmp uses SAJHA's FMP_API_KEY; benzinga, intrinio, polygon, tiingo need a key in ~/.openbb_platform/user_settings.json.
Example: {"symbol": "AAPL", "limit": 5}
